caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a bonnet or cap, shown in profile against a plain, light-colored background. The bonnet is composed of a fine, lace-like material, illustrated with intricate, repetitive floral and leaf patterns rendered in shades of gray and black. The lacework consists of small, rounded shapes and motifs distributed evenly across the surface, with areas of denser patterning creating subtle variations in tone. The bonnet has a gently domed form, with two elongated extensions at the bottom edge, possibly representing ties or flaps. The lines and shading are delicate, contributing to the detailed depiction of the fabric’s texture and transparency. The overall color palette of the drawing is monochromatic, with the primary contrast between the dark details of the lace and the lighter background.
title: Baby's Lace Cap
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
